_comment: Why a pipeline run failed, in plain words, and what fixes it. scripts/diagnose.py matches a failed run's log against these, first match wins, and prints only this text: never a line of the log, so a check or comment on this public repository cannot repeat anything private. Add an entry the first time a failure needs investigating, so it never needs investigating twice.

diagnoses.title: The registry refused the push
diagnoses.fix: This repository cannot write the image package. In the package's settings on GitHub, under Manage Actions access, give this repository the Write role, then re-run.

diagnoses.title: HQ's app is missing a permission
diagnoses.fix: The app's installation lacks a permission this step needs. Compare the app's permissions with deploy/github-apps.json, accept the change on the installation, then re-run.

diagnoses.match: (A JSON web token could not be decoded|Bad credentials|Integration not found|could not create installation access token)
diagnoses.title: HQ's app key was refused
diagnoses.fix: The app's key or client ID in this repository's Actions secrets does not match the app. Run scripts/wire-github-app.py again with the current key.

diagnoses.title: The composition set is missing
diagnoses.fix: The COMPOSITION_EXTENSIONS secret is unset or empty. Restore it in this repository's Actions secrets.

diagnoses.match: an extension has no successful admission on main
diagnoses.title: An extension has not been admitted
diagnoses.fix: One extension has no successful admission on its main branch. Open its repository's Verify and admit plugin runs and fix or re-run the latest.

diagnoses.match: (Host image is not signed|Host image never appeared|Host build (failure|cancelled|timed_out))
diagnoses.title: There was no signed host image to compose onto
diagnoses.fix: The HQ run for this commit did not publish a signed host image. Fix that run's failing job; the composition follows it.

diagnoses.title: An admission's signature did not verify
diagnoses.fix: An extension's signed admission does not match the signer this repository declares for it. Re-run that extension's admission from main; if its workflow moved, update the composition set.

diagnoses.title: The image has a fixable serious vulnerability
diagnoses.fix: A HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerability with a published fix is in the image. Update the package or base image the scan's error names, then re-run.

diagnoses.title: The admitted extensions do not compose
diagnoses.fix: Cordon or the host refused the admitted set as one composition: a wheel that is not its admitted artifact, a duplicate, or mixed admission policies. The reason is in the run's sealed failure logs (scripts/failure-logs.sh RUN_ID).

diagnoses.title: The composed application did not start
diagnoses.fix: The composed image raised before its suite ran, usually settings or an extension that does not load against this host. The exception's type is in the log, the rest in the run's sealed failure logs (scripts/failure-logs.sh RUN_ID).

diagnoses.title: A coordinated extension branch did not build
diagnoses.fix: The branch named for this pull request did not build a wheel. Its build output is in the run's sealed failure logs (scripts/failure-logs.sh RUN_ID); fix it in that branch and push again.

diagnoses.title: The image did not come up healthy
diagnoses.fix: The container never reported healthy within 90 seconds of booting as production does. For the host image its log follows the error; for the composed image it is in the run's sealed failure logs (scripts/failure-logs.sh RUN_ID).

diagnoses.title: The composed application failed its tests
diagnoses.fix: The suite failed inside the composed image. A failing host test is named in the log; an extension's are only counted, and their output is in the run's sealed failure logs (scripts/failure-logs.sh RUN_ID). The fix belongs in the host or that extension.

diagnoses.match: not signed by this repository's compose workflow
diagnoses.title: The image to deploy is not signed by this repository
diagnoses.fix: Production only runs a composition this repository's Compose workflow signed. Run Compose for this commit instead of deploying an image published some other way.

diagnoses.title: The new controller could not use a connection, and was rolled back
diagnoses.fix: Production still runs the previous image. Which connection, and why, is in the host's private log at /var/log/severino-hq/controller-preflight.log. A provider that briefly did not answer is retried and forgiven; anything left there is a refused credential or the new code, so fix that and merge again.

diagnoses.match: (New image did not become healthy|Application replacement failed|Controller activation failed)
diagnoses.title: The new version did not come up healthy, and was rolled back
diagnoses.fix: Production still runs the previous image. What the deploy, sync or installer printed is in the private logs on the deploy host (/var/log/severino-hq), and the application's in HQ's own; fix it and merge again.

diagnoses.title: The deploy host is short on disk
diagnoses.fix: The machine needs at least 512 MiB free to deploy. Prune unused images on it, then re-run the deploy.

diagnoses.title: The deploy host could not pull the image
diagnoses.fix: Production still runs the previous image. The registry was unreachable from the machine or refused it; re-run the deploy.

diagnoses.match: (TLS handshake timeout|Could not resolve host|connection reset by peer|502 Bad Gateway|503 Service Unavailable|i/o timeout)
diagnoses.title: A service did not answer
diagnoses.fix: GitHub, the registry or a download host was briefly unreachable. Nothing is wrong with the change; re-run the failed job.
